verdict.rationale: Notte's docs and marketing strongly support the story: agents are given natural-language tasks to complete multi-step web flows (navigate/login/extract), with concrete examples like the LinkedIn login-and-extract task and 'Describe a task. Watch it happen. No selectors, no maintenance.' However, a hands-on community report states a real-world extraction task on hyatt.com 'completely failed,' and the founder admits captcha/anti-bot handling only works for ~60% of providers, directly contradicting the polished end-to-end claim in some real scenarios. Missing for 10: independent successful reproductions of complex multi-step flows, and resolution of the reported failure case.
